title: 15.67. Niyyānikaduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Niyyānikaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyyāniko nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Aniyyānikaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyyāniko nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
Aniyyānikaṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyyāniko naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ. (Abyākatamūlaṁ dve paccayavasena.)
